info.name: Infoblox WAPI (Web API) DHCP IP Address Management API

params.name: _return_fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of field names to include in the response. Use _return_fields+ to add fields to the default set.

params.name: _max_results
params.description: The maximum number of results to return. The default is 1000. Use a negative value to return all results.

params.name: network
params.description: Filter by the network in CIDR notation.

params.name: status
params.description: Filter by the IP address status.

params.name: network_view
params.description: Filter by the network view name.

items.docs: Retrieves a list of IPv4 address objects. This is a read-only object that provides information about the usage and status of IPv4 addresses in the Infoblox system. Supports filtering by IP address, network, status, and associated names.
